task.title: M6: Go import extraction and package-level resolver with module-level edges
task.description:
Complete the Go adapter. Add an import query to the Go language config and a package-level resolver: imports are resolved against the module path from go.mod to a package directory inside the repo (kind: 'package' modules) or classified as external for the standard library and third-party modules. Edges are emitted at level 'module' only, between packages, with no file-level edges. Verify the graph and compare views on the workbook repository, which is the Go dogfood target.

Acceptance criteria:
- Go snapshots contain modules[] with kind 'package' (one per directory with .go files, id = import path) and edges[] with level 'module'.
- Resolver reads the module path from go.mod, handles nested modules and replace directives minimally, and marks stdlib and external modules as external.
- No file-level Go edges are emitted; the walker's import query is the only addition to the Go config.
- codeviz serve on the workbook repo shows a correct package graph with cycles highlighted if any, and codeviz compare between two workbook tags shows package-level edge changes.
- Fixture tests cover intra-module, stdlib, and third-party imports.
